address: Valckenierstraat 65, Amsterdam-Centrum (Roeterseiland): 1963 university laboratory block, four storeys of brick ribbon windows with cream bands over a dark plinth, a two-storey steel-window canal wing and a brick tower with a chimney stack
notes: Valckenierstraat 65 (BAG pand 0363100012170734, built 1963, 81 3DBAG wall surfaces, roof max 32.8 m): a university laboratory block of the Roeterseiland campus on the Nieuwe Achtergracht, a square four-storey brick ring round a courtyard with a brick tower and chimney stack at its north-east corner. Four walls are photographed: the south front (w01-163, 2018-05-08), the west front (w03-253, 2020-02-14), the north canal wing (w04-343, 2017-07-06) and the chimney tower (w06-343, 2021-01-22); w05-343 is the underside of the bridge and shows nothing.

walls[0] = panels 32 and 12 (S, 69 m and 37 m, eaves 16.1): a dark brick plinth, cream stone bands between the floors and three storeys of paired and triple windows in grey frames, drawn as 4 storeys x 14 bays with string courses. walls[1] = panel 14 (S, eaves 18.9 over a 16.1 m base): the set-back top floor, one ribbon-window storey. walls[2] = panels 64 and 61 (W, 54 m and 22 m, eaves 16.1): the same four storeys x 11 bays. walls[3] = panels 2 and 10 (N, 37 m and 11 m, eaves 9.3): the two-storey steel-window laboratory wing over brick bands, drawn as two ribbon-window storeys in a dark frame colour.

Simplified: the brick plinth is the ground storey of the same brick, the stone bands are string courses, window groups are evenly spaced bays; the chimney tower and the two stair towers are the 3DBAG mass in brick colour (the second chimney stack and the roof plant are not modelled). Not drawn: the east front, the courtyard walls and the tower faces, which stay blank wall (no panorama within 35 m).

Measured 2026-10-14 (measure.ts, evidence in measured.json): groups 0, 2, 3 take the photo's wall and glass colour, window shape, bay count and front class; walls[2] glass #544f3e not used (not darker than the wall #765e52 by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept; walls[3] glass #444946 not used (not darker than the wall #4e4740 by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept.
